English: Snow Shelter
Basic snow-packed lean-tos provide rudimentary protection against the Arctic chill, allowing the clan to survive the harshest nights.
Ice Block Hut
Huts of stacked ice blocks offer hardier shelter, improving survival and the ability to house more nomads.
Windbreak Tent
Portable hide tents ringed with snow walls, shielding the camp from wind and enabling population growth.
Fur-Lined Yurt
Sturdy yurts lined with thick furs, providing warmth and comfort for a growing nomadic population.
Frost Storage
Large subterranean storage pits insulated with ice, allowing surplus supplies for major population and army support.
Seal Oil Lamp Post
Rows of seal oil lamps light the camp, deterring predators and brightening the endless night, inspiring unity.
Igloo Cluster
A permanent cluster of interconnected igloos forms a true arctic village, sustaining a thriving, mobile population.
Blizzard Refuge
A fortified, insulated refuge with layered snow barriers, capable of protecting the entire clan from the fiercest storms.
Tundra Outpost
A strategically placed outpost, enabling the clan to exert control and move swiftly across the tundra.
Polar Stronghold
A nearly impenetrable arctic bastion—massive, insulated, and fiercely defended—serving as the heart of the clans polar domain.
